findings.fix: Add a `## References` section citing N. Hungerbühler, M. Wasem, *Non-integer valued winding numbers and a generalized Residue Theorem*, arXiv:1808.00997, Proposition 2.3 (and its proof's one-sided/corner treatment, p. 9), matching the sibling files.
findings.issue: The new file defining `HasLipschitzDerivOnEachSideAt` — HW Prop 2.3's C^{1,1} crossing-regularity hypothesis, in the per-side form HW's own proof uses at a corner — names no source: it has neither a `## References` nor a `## Provenance` section, unlike every sibling in this family (`Winding/BoundedIntegrand.lean:38`, `Winding/LipschitzBoundedIntegrand.lean:40`, `Winding/RealIntegral/Basic.lean:36`, `Winding/RealIntegral/OnCurve.lean:86`).

summary: HW Prop 2.3 is credited in the PR description, in OnCurve.lean's References (with the p. 9 corner-splitting citation) and in LipschitzBoundedIntegrand.lean, and the reused infrastructure is named by declaration with AINTLIB provenance intact upstream. The one gap is the new predicate file, which encodes HW's C^{1,1} crossing hypothesis with no source named.
